title: Policy-Bound Execution Evidence
finding: Verification evidence is only interpretable relative to a named, content-addressed test policy; policy identity still does not authenticate the evidence source.
predicate: VERIFIED = C AND R AND A AND S AND H AND P AND T

predicates.C: receipt commit and github_sha equal independently sourced tested commit SHA; github_head_sha separately equals pull-request source head SHA
predicates.R: workflow run ID and attempt match
predicates.S: all policy-required suites have independent passing evidence
predicates.H: actual bytes of a separate evidence artifact hash to the expected digest
predicates.P: receipt and run evidence bind to SHA256 of canonical verification-policy.json
predicates.T: run evidence is obtained from an authenticated trusted source

limits: Policy hash identifies bytes but does not establish scientific adequacy
Trusted provenance must be authenticated by the collector, not a caller boolean alone
Artifact digest must be calculated over actual downloaded bytes
A receipt cannot contain its own enclosing archive digest without a self-reference problem
Full repository tests and hosted CI have not been verified for this draft
Pull-request source-head SHA and tested merge SHA are distinct identities and must not be conflated
